_: PREREG A1: observation columns allowed to sit at zero variance over the corpus, one reason per group, fnmatch patterns over schema_check.col_name. A LIST value is a STRUCTURAL group: a proof from law/config/roster that the setting event is unreachable, so the column holds constant for any corpus length. A structural group may also be written as an OBJECT with `patterns` and `a17_exempt: true` when its proof is ROSTER behaviour rather than law (the scripted anchor never says mew; a policy may): A1 treats it as structural, A17 does not red it for moving. An OBJECT value with `expected_per_1000` is a RARE group (owner ruling 2026-09-04): the wiring is shown alive (a sibling column on the same encoder loop moved, or a forced emission) and only incidence is unknown; its constant columns read UNPROVEN, and turn RED once the corpus is 5x the expected waiting time (expected_per_1000 = setting events per 1000 corpus ticks, all cats; null = no estimate yet, never red). A rare group whose columns all moved is reported stale, the good outcome.
